ModMetaData.name: Game Test Loader (test only)
ModMetaData.author: test scripts
ModMetaData.description: Test-only helper of the save-safety script (run-savesafety.ps1). Never published. With -testloader-loadsave=NAME it loads that save from the main menu, plays some ticks, resaves it as NAME-resaved, reports every error by phase and quits.
